states: Before/after pair on pulse-dev: production builds of the parent d2ac0c5112 (origin/main) and of this tree, each embedded with go build and run as a DEMO_MODE mock stack (ports 7771/7772, fresh data dirs, telemetry off), driven by the same headless Chromium script.

Small mock estate for both builds (PULSE_MOCK_NODES=6, 4 VMs and 4 LXCs per node, 2 Docker hosts, 6 containers, 2 generic hosts): on the default 50-node estate the parent itself stalls before serving (startup watchdog fires during the initial alert evaluation; the backend is identical in both builds and is reported separately), while the small estate starts in about 15 s.

Both builds, both overviews, both widths: exactly one workload FilterBar on the page (aria-label "Proxmox workload filters" / "vSphere workload filters"), zero filter groups and zero inputs inside [data-testid=workloads-page], zero toolbars with the default "Workloads filters" label or default search placeholder, and the page toolbar precedes the surface in document order.

Search for a guest name narrows the embedded table to that one row (Proxmox auth-service-01: 55 to 1 at desktop, 36 to 1 at phone; vSphere etl-batch-01: 18 to 1); a no-match search shows the surface empty state "No guests found / No guests match your search" and Clear filters restores 55 / 18 rows.
Opening a guest drawer shows the page toolbar "Clear pinned selection" button; clicking it closes the drawer and the button goes away, at both widths on both pages.
Kiosk mode (?kiosk=1, sessionStorage pulse_kiosk_mode=true) shows the same single page toolbar in both builds; only the deleted branch ever read kiosk mode.

Results JSON: all 104 measurements identical between the builds, including the toolbar/surface chrome signature (tag, test id, role, aria-label multiset outside tbody) on all four page/width pairs. The only failing request in either build is the demo-mode 403 on POST /api/usage/workload-history; no page errors.

Dist proof: 189 files each side; 94 byte-identical, 92 differ only in chunk-hash names and SRI strings, 3 differ in code. After normalising hashes and 1-3 character identifiers, Proxmox-*.js and Vmware-*.js lose only suppressFilterToolbar:!0 on the WorkloadsSurface mount, and WorkloadsSurface-*.js loses only the toolbar JSX and its show-condition, the useKioskMode() call and kioskMode state entry, and the defaultSortKey fallbacks. CSS unchanged.

check-bundle-size.mjs passes on both builds: WorkloadsSurface 57.25 kB to 56.86 kB gzip (baseline 61.07, cap 70.23), Proxmox 78.85 to 78.83, Vmware 11.24 to 11.24, total JS 1367.68 to 1367.27 kB; no chunk renamed, .bundlesize.json unchanged.
interactions: Demo sign-in, then for /proxmox/overview and /vmware/overview: wait for guest rows, count toolbars and inputs inside and outside the surface, record the chrome signature, screenshot.

Type the first guest name into the page search, read the row count, then type a no-match term, read the empty state, click Clear filters (or clear the box at phone width) and read the restored row count.
Click the first guest row name cell to open its inline drawer, read the Clear pinned selection button, click it, confirm the drawer closed.
Repeat in a 1440x900 desktop context and a 390x844 touch phone context, then load both overviews with ?kiosk=1 in a fresh context and count toolbars and rows; screenshots of every state inspected.
